notes: Fixed the Automatic Installer page so it no longer stays empty when software-status checks fail or when the list is reopened after the first scan.
changelog: v0.2.28 - Fixed the Automatic Installer page so it no longer stays empty when software-status checks fail or when the list is reopened after the first scan.
v0.2.27 - Added automatic DPI-aware resizing for the splash screen, main window, and card layout so the interface stays clear on different monitor sizes and scaling modes.
v0.2.26 - Fixed online Office installation by switching from invalid winget package IDs to Microsoft Office Deployment Tool with proper product IDs and installed-version detection.
v0.2.25 - Fixed missing buttons in Office Install Center and Secret Install by increasing card height and using more compact text wrapping for those menus.
v0.2.24 - Fixed the Nexus Admin create/delete user cards so their buttons stay visible and tightened the local user create/delete input handling.
v0.2.23 - Fixed the Nexus Admin card layout and moved all program selection flow into the Automatic Installer, removing the separate selector entry points.
v0.2.22 - Adjusted the Office Deployment Center layout so the long cards on page 4 have enough height and wider text wrapping.
v0.2.21 - Fixed the Office Install Center card layout so the last two boxes keep the same button area and match the other cards.
v0.2.20 - Added a full Windows 10 activation menu with save, show, clear, and run actions, matching the Windows 11 workflow.
v0.2.19 - Fixed product key entry so Windows 11 and Office key dialogs switch to English keyboard layout and normalize Cyrillic input automatically.
v0.2.18 - Reworked the desktop icons option so it enables the real Windows desktop icons for This PC, Network, Control Panel, and User Files with a visible progress window.
v0.2.17 - Fixed the desktop icons button so it now creates working WGA shortcuts on the desktop, including direct menu shortcuts.
v0.2.16 - Removed the password prompt from the Windows 11 activation menu and kept the updated version detection fix.
v0.2.15 - Fixed repeated update notifications after updating by syncing and reading the correct version file from the installed build.
v0.2.14 - Improved online package downloads so extraction shows live progress and the next package starts visibly after the current one finishes.
v0.2.13 - Added a faster startup USB check and blocked the installer before opening when no allowed USB device is found.
v0.2.12 - Restricted setup to USB storage only and blocked all local installations.
v0.2.11 - Restricted setup to USB flash drives and external SSD devices only.
v0.2.10 - Fixed the USB-only setup flow so the installer no longer falls back to a remembered C drive path.
v0.2.9 - Added a USB-only setup package with launcher, autorun files, and drive-root preparation for external media.
v0.2.8 - Added a loading screen for software checks and expanded the installer menu with all detected local tools.
v0.2.7 - Expanded the program selector, improved installed software detection, and fixed Adobe Reader replacement flow.
v0.2.6 - Added install flow checks for existing software, optional removal, and clearer progress steps.
v0.2.5 - Added a new separate program selector window with checkboxes for bulk installation.
v0.2.4 - Fixed portable Installers folder creation next to WGA.exe on flash drives.
v0.2.3 - Fixed online package downloads so they continue after closing the progress window and show extraction progress.
v0.2.2 - Fixed installer manifest reading with UTF-8 BOM and old portable manifest fallback.
v0.2.1 - Fixed resource manifest selection so online downloads work after updating from older portable builds.
v0.2.0 - Added online installer resources from networkbgs.com with speed, ETA, package count, and SHA256 verification.
v0.1.9 - Added cache-busting update metadata checks to prevent stale GitHub raw responses.
v0.1.8 - Switched update metadata and package downloads to refs/heads/main to avoid stale GitHub raw cache.
v0.1.7 - Fixed automatic updater download path and added WGA-update.log diagnostics.
v0.1.6 - Added automatic installer menu with checkboxes and one-click sequential installation.
v0.1.5 - Added update history button and popup notification for available updates.
v0.1.4 - Added automatic update installer with download, file replacement, and restart.
v0.1.3 - Added Bulgarian update messages and clearer GitHub raw diagnostics.
v0.1.2 - Added language status panel, Adobe Reader version check, resource manager, icon, and UI fixes.
